reviews.title: Exceptional Hanging Microphone for Church Audio Needs
reviews.comment:
As a church sound engineer, I’m always on the lookout for reliable and high-quality microphones that enhance clarity and coverage. The Audio-Technica PRO 45 ProPoint Cardioid Condenser Hanging Microphone has been an outstanding addition to our setup.
Why It’s Perfect for Church Use:
Crystal-Clear Sound: The cardioid pickup pattern is fantastic at isolating sound from the choir or speakers, minimizing background noise while capturing every detail beautifully. It’s especially great for larger sanctuaries.
Discreet and Professional Design: The sleek, black finish blends seamlessly into our ceiling-mounted setup, making it nearly invisible to the congregation while looking professional.
Versatile Placement: The hanging design allows precise positioning, and it covers wide areas effectively. It’s ideal for choir sections, acoustic instruments, or overhead speech capture.
Durable Build: This mic is built to last. It’s handled weekly use in our services and events without any signs of wear or performance issues.
Easy Integration: It works seamlessly with our existing audio equipment and is easy to adjust and manage. Setup was straightforward, and it delivers consistent performance every time.
This microphone has significantly improved the sound quality of our live services and recordings. Whether you’re mic’ing a choir, ensemble, or a specific section of the stage, the PRO 45 delivers exceptional clarity and reliability. Highly recommend it for any church or venue looking for a high-quality hanging microphone.
reviews.author: Papa Dunn

reviews.title: Good quality mics.
reviews.comment: I bought two of these for use in a musical production to pick up singing by the larger cast on stage and also to record the cast/chorus for one scene for playback.  These did a great job.  They are small and have great hangers and long cords.  They are probably not top of the line, but they did great.  A note about using stage mics for live performances.  We used a graphic EQ with these to find and remove the feedback frequency for the mics and hall, so we could get more gain out of them.  They were perfect for recording a group of about 30 people.  I would recommend these for use on stage, and the price is right.

reviews.title: clean, sensitive
reviews.comment:
great product.  I don't find anything flat about it's response but I love it's clarity and what I can do with what it picks up!  Perfect mic for the $.  who knows, maybe it really sounds like that 10' up!
Using as blend for live recording, I pick up the house sound with this mic and lay the soundboard signal on top of it; with the right eq on this mic it makes for a great rich, clear mix.  Without the eq it sounds like it's in a tube.
update on review: In looking back, I think the mic has a perfectly flat response and it did sound really different 10' up in our venue where I had the mic hanging.  I love the mic, it is very directional which means you can point it in a manner that avoids feedback and you can choose what you pick up with it.  Great mic for the money.
